bugs.bug: parsePropPath's /\w+|\[(\w*)]/g splits field names on every non-word character, so a name like `user-name` or `user name` is broken into nested path segments
bugs.example: formDataToJSON.js: parsePropPath uses /\w+|\[(\w*)]/g, so a field named 'user-name' is split at the hyphen into ['user','name'] and becomes a nested object
